seo.title: Oneisall: AI-generated ad creatives on Amazon Ads - +50% sales, -22% ACOS (2025)
seo.meta_description: Oneisall replaced its white-background visuals with AI-generated lifestyle images (Amazon Ads Image Generator): sales +50% year over year and ACOS -22% in the UK.
seo.resume_citable: Oneisall generated its Amazon Ads creatives with the image generator (genAI) in the UK in 2025 and reports sales up 50% year over year, ACOS down 22%, and share of voice up 50% on its main keyword category.

faq.q: What does the AI generate in this Amazon case?
faq.a: Lifestyle ad images: the tool places the product in context from the product listing, to replace white-background visuals in the Sponsored formats.

faq.q: Why move from white background to lifestyle?
faq.a: Amazon documents that ads showing the product in context can have a click-through rate 40 percent higher than white-background visuals.

pattern: AI image generation for retail media creatives
objectif_business: Produce in-context ad visuals (products shown in a setting) with no studio or photo budget, to keep up with the pace of creatives that Sponsored campaigns on Amazon demand.
points_cles: AI-generated lifestyle images to replace white-background visuals.
Amazon Ads Image Generator tool, served across Sponsored Brands, Products, and Display.
Sales up 50% year over year, ACOS down 22% in the UK.
Evidence B, confirmed status and an expanding tool.
description: Oneisall, a maker of connected pet products, used the Amazon Ads image generator to replace its white-background visuals with AI-generated lifestyle images. The advertiser starts from the product listing; the tool produces images that place the product in a setting, served in the Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Products, and Sponsored Display formats. In the UK market in 2025, the brand reports a 50 percent year-over-year increase in sales, a 22 percent drop in ACOS, and a 50 percent gain in share of voice on its main keyword category. This is a generation case: the AI produces the ad visuals, whereas bid optimization is a separate mechanism. Amazon also documents that ads showing the product in context can have a click-through rate 40 percent higher than white-background visuals.

resultats.metrique: Share of voice on the main keyword category
Click-through rate, product in context vs white background (Amazon Ads data)

niveau_preuve.justification: Quantified Amazon Ads platform case study naming Oneisall and its Commercial Director; an official interested source, hence B. The tool and the order of magnitude of the creative gain are confirmed by Amazon's product communications.

stack_technique.detail: GenAI image generator integrated into the Amazon Ads console: it produces lifestyle visuals placing the product in a setting from the product listing. Underlying model not published by Amazon.
Amazon Ads formats in which the generated visuals are served and measured (sales, ACOS, share of voice).
Amazon Ads' genAI creative suite expanded in 2025 (images and video), the natural successor to the image generator for scaling up.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: By campaign and by creative test: images are generated on demand when a new creative is needed, then put into rotation.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: The brand's retail media / marketing team, in the Amazon Ads console.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: Creative performance (click-through rate, attributed sales, ACOS) that indicates which image to push. Without reading this performance, the generation runs with no improvement loop.

etapes.detail: The team picks the product listing from which to generate the visuals.
The tool produces several lifestyle images placing the product in a setting.
The selected visuals feed Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Products, and Sponsored Display.
Tracking of sales, ACOS, and share of voice to keep the best creatives.

playbook.action: Pick a best-seller product and generate a series of lifestyle images from the product listing in the Amazon Ads console.
playbook.livrable: 5-10 candidate visuals selected by the team

playbook.action: Launch a Sponsored Brands test at equal budget: generated lifestyle visuals against existing white-background visuals.
Read click-through rate, attributed sales, and ACOS; cut losing creatives, keep the winners.
playbook.livrable: Documented test read with the retained creatives

playbook.action: Extend to other products and to the Sponsored Products and Display formats, and set up the labeling process for generated visuals (AI Act).
playbook.livrable: Library of genAI creatives + labeling process

replication.equipe: 1 retail media lead (in-house or agency); no photo studio or data profile needed
prerequis_data: access to the Amazon Ads console
prerequis_orga: retail media team able to test creatives
labeling process for generated visuals (AI Act)
replication.premiere_etape: Generate lifestyle images for a best-seller product and test them in Sponsored Brands against the white-background visuals.

statut_vivant.note: Amazon Ads' image generator is a standard tool, expanded in 2025 (AI Creative Studio, Video Generator). A live and expanding feature.

transposable_ue.note: The case is already European (UK deployment). The tool generates lifestyle images from the product, with no individual profiling; low GDPR exposure. Watch the AI Act on labeling AI-generated visuals.
